title: 3Sum Smaller
description: Find the number of index triplets (i, j, k) such that i < j < k and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] < target.
pseudocode:
1. sort(nums)
2. count = 0
3. for i from 0 to n-3:
4.   left = i + 1, right = n - 1
5.   while left < right:
6.     if nums[i] + nums[left] + nums[right] < target:
7.       count += (right - left)
8.       left++
9.     else:
10.      right--

steps.note: Sort the array to enable the two-pointer approach.
Initialize left pointer at 1 (0) and right pointer at 3 (3).
Check sum: -2 + 0 + 3 = 1. Since 1 < 2, all elements between left and right form valid triplets.
Add (right - left) = 2 to count. Total count = 2.
Check sum: -2 + 1 + 3 = 2. Since 2 is not < 2, move to else block.
Decrement right pointer to index 2. Left is no longer < right, loop terminates.
